reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I have been a client of **Casa do Vet** for over seven years. It took me a long time to write this review. Not because of a lack of satisfaction or appreciation, but because some experiences are so profound that finding words capable of translating what they represent is a difficult task.

Over these years, we have experienced many moments of joy, care, consultations, and follow-ups. But it was during the most painful moments in my family's life that I understood the true greatness of this team.

**Because we are not just talking about pets. We are talking about love. About family.** Of lives that are part of our history and leave eternal marks on our hearts.**
And it was precisely in moments of loss, when the pain seemed greater than any word of comfort, that A Casa do Vet demonstrated something that goes far beyond technical excellence: **humanity, empathy, sensitivity, and immense respect for the love we feel for our animals.**
The way we were welcomed, the affection, the gentleness, the dignity, and the respect dedicated not only to our little companions but also to us as a family are experiences we will never forget.
It is relatively easy to recognize the quality of a service in happy moments. But it is in the most difficult moments, when we are vulnerable and need support, that we truly know the values ​​of those who are by our side.
**And A Casa do Vet was by our side with a humanity that cannot be taught in books but is revealed in the gestures, sensitivity, and heart of each professional.**
Therefore, this is not just a five-star or million-star review. It is a testimony in a moment of loss but of profound gratitude.

Gratitude for finding technically prepared professionals, but above all, human beings capable of understanding that behind each animal, there is an entire family that loves, suffers, and deserves respect.
My sincere wish is that you never lose that essence, that extraordinary empathy that distinguishes you and makes such a difference in the lives of those who entrust you with what is most precious to them.
May success always be a consequence of this very special way of practicing the profession. Because, in the end, **it's not just about taking care of animals. It's about honoring the love that exists between them and their families.**
And you knew how to do that in an unforgettable way.
**My respect, my admiration, and my eternal gratitude to the entire Casa do Vet team.**
Because excellence generates trust. But it is humanity that leaves lasting marks. ❤️🐾 From Rita and Leandro, animal parents and the furry family - Zpets - Zaza, Zizi, Zoey, Z Amora and Z Olivia and our little stars Bajah, Minguau, Vash, Paulo Zulu and Zuma.  Thank youuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuu!!!

I've been following Casa do Vet since it opened and I can attest that they continue to evolve. I especially want to highlight the management of Ms. Bruna, who is always welcoming and caring towards pets and their owners. She sets an example of how the team should provide service. Congratulations!

Impeccable service.
Dr. Nayara is a competent and lovely professional!

I came to know Casa do Vet during an extremely delicate moment.

My niece, an exceptional little cat, needed to be hospitalized and was under the team's care for about three days. Unfortunately, the outcome wasn't what we hoped for. Her condition was very serious, and despite all our efforts, she passed away.

Even so, I want to express how much we were welcomed and supported throughout this entire process.

Even in the face of a very serious case and a very delicate clinical state, the team was 100% attentive, present, and committed. Dr. Bruno, Dr. Julia, and Dr. Leonardo, thank you so much!

They were by our side, sought alternatives, suggested procedures, explained possibilities, and, within the limits of veterinary medicine, we tried everything possible.

Unfortunately, this time, we lost the battle. But at no point did we feel like we had given up trying or that we were alone in that situation.

And that makes all the difference.

At a time when families are fragile, scared, and trying to make the best decisions for a beloved animal, having a present, caring team willing to find solutions makes a huge difference.

Therefore, even with a heavy heart over the outcome, my gratitude to Casa do Vet is immense.

I wish all pet owners could have, in such difficult times, the same support, care, and warmth that we received here. ❤️

Excellent clinic in the heart of Tijuca (and very close to my house - which made me very happy). I took one of my cats there and was pleasantly surprised. Great service, from the reception to the team of vets. They are very attentive, helpful, polite and caring.
Excellent service! I highly recommend it ☺️
Hi Emanuella! Thank you for the feedback and come back anytime :)

My dog ​​was going through a difficult time. We were received very warmly. Everyone was incredibly caring. Doing what you love makes you unique. That's them! I highly recommend them. Don't worry, Leopoldo (my dog) is doing well, thank God.

I had been seen there before and was reasonably satisfied in the past. I called on Friday asking if I could get blood tests done for my pet. The attendant on WhatsApp said it had to be scheduled. Okay, and she said that if it was through the health plan, it was only on Thursdays with an appointment. I found it absurd that they only accept the plan on Thursdays to do a test! Even canine medicine has become a business now! Shameful! If they accept the Petlove plan, they should accept it every day!!!
Very good, I recommend it!
They welcomed my little corgi very well. The girls are lovely and love what they do. I highly recommend them.

My Shih Tzu, Gaia, looooves it.

For baths, vaccinations, and being pampered.

And we love it too.
A wonderful, dedicated, competent, and welcoming team.
We are very happy with our choice.
We recommend them.

The Pet Love app praised the clinic, but I just moved from São Paulo to Rio de Janeiro and what a disappointment! There, we received excellent service, with clinics that don't discriminate based on whether you're on insurance or not; on the contrary, the service was top-notch. There's co-participation in each procedure, it's not free, so at the very least you expect to be well taken care of. However, the clinic claims they don't have something as basic as the V10 vaccine covered by the plan. I find it surreal... honestly, it's better to look for clinics in the South Zone than in Tijuca. You look for convenience due to proximity, relying on references from reviews/Gemini, but the first contact is already disappointing.

My experience with Casa do Vet has been excellent. The entire team is very attentive, caring, and patient, always treating the animals with great care and respect. You can feel the affection and dedication in every interaction, which gives us, the pet owners, a lot of peace of mind. I highly recommend them!

Dr. Vitor is a wonderful oncologist.
As for general practitioners in general, we don't consult them.
Excellent veterinarians and very well-done grooming. My dogs are very well cared for.
Excellent service!
Casa do Vet is fantastic. All the professionals are excellent and very kind. My dog ​​always wags his tail when he goes in there to receive affection from everyone. I wouldn't trade it for anything.
The team was extremely attentive, they helped us in an emergency, and the 4 puppies now have a new clinic to monitor them all.

Poor service
I didn't receive proper guidance
My pet wasn't even examined.
They were extremely attentive. They always sent me photos and videos whenever I contacted them and were very quick to respond. I recommend them!

The clinic is perfect! They were a light at the end of the tunnel when my dog ​​needed emergency surgery on a holiday; all the professionals are very competent and attentive. I have no words to express my gratitude ❤️
Our cat FRED received very affectionate treatment.
They always treated our dog with great affection.

I want to express my immense gratitude for the care and attention you gave Zion. I went through a very desperate moment when he swallowed a trachea and needed an emergency endoscopy to remove the foreign object from his esophagus.
Thank God everything turned out alright, and that was also thanks to the attention and competence of the team. I felt very safe entrusting my pet to your care!
You are attentive and humane professionals ❤️

I went to PetLove for a general practitioner appointment for my French bulldog. The place is nice. Clean, but without many special features. We were seen by Dr. Nicolle, who seemed new to the profession, although she was thorough in several aspects and professionally offered possible solutions for all of them. Both she and the receptionist were very kind. I recommend it to everyone!

Excellent service, amazing professionals. They took care of my kitten who had been injured on a super busy day, and even so, the service was incredible.

The new space is very good too!
I want to thank Dr. Júlia, who has treated us several times with great care and accuracy. Just by looking at us, she correctly diagnosed the condition. Thank you very much, Dr. Júlia.

The clinic is simply perfect! I have five kittens and they are always treated with so much love and care.

Dr. Isabella Cerreia is wonderful! I highly recommend her!

They treated my kitten in an emergency even though they were in the process of moving. They were extremely compassionate, gave us all the support, and did everything to ensure he was treated in the best possible way, even during such an unusual time. They never let us down!

My husband and I trust the clinic completely! We are very happy that they moved to a larger space where they can expand in the best way. You deserve all the success in the world! 🐾

They didn't know how to take care of my kitten; they used a catheter that was thicker than necessary to drain his urine. He's been trying to recover for over a week, but he's still having urinary incontinence and is in pain.
Attention and affection in the care of pets.

The best possible!!! Excellent service, the veterinarian Isabela is kind, empathetic and very accurate... in addition to being a sweetheart with our kitten Miojo (the little rascal of the house).

The prices are fair and the best in terms of cost-benefit.

We are very satisfied, but, above all, SAFE with this clinic!! I highly recommend it!!!

I spent 3 months trying to get treatment for my bulldog at various veterinarians, and it only got worse. Only Dr. Bruno had the attention and interest to find out the problem. She's still undergoing treatment, but now with a clear direction. Thank you, Dr. Bruno and your team. Melinda will get better, I have faith.

I want to express our gratitude for everything you did for Emy, from the emergency room visit with Dr. Isabella and Dr. Nayara, and then throughout her hospitalization and the care provided by Dr. Bruno and all the professionals who attended to and cared for her with such affection. Thanks to all of this, Emy is well and at home! Thank you so much for everything!

The service is wonderful, from the reception staff to the veterinarians. They are always helpful, very attentive, and patient! The WhatsApp contact is very efficient; they always respond clearly, in detail, and are always willing to answer all questions.

My first experience at the establishment was satisfactory. However, on my second visit, they refused to bathe my Shih Tzu, which had been scheduled a week in advance, claiming that the fur on her paws was matted. I emphasize that when we schedule a service, we organize our commitments and routines around it. For this reason, I consider it essential that the establishment informs customers, with due advance notice, of the impossibility of performing the service in cases like this—and not just refuse service upon arrival, especially on a weekend. Such conduct demonstrates a lack of consideration for the customer.
I received excellent service before and during the consultation and vaccination appointment for my two kittens. I recommend them.
Excellent service!

I spent quite a long time at the door today, around 10:00 AM. The television was on, signs that there were indeed people at the clinic. I rang the intercom, called the phone, tried every way to get in touch to be attended to, and nothing. I had to take an Uber and find another place. I found it very regrettable that there wasn't even someone to let us in. I won't be back, because if it's a 24-hour clinic, how is it possible to arrive there needing to see a patient and then spend so much time at the door without being able to get in?
My pet was very well cared for and looks beautiful!!

If I could, I would give a thousand stars! I went in blindly, based on the reviews here and the 24-hour service, since I was looking on a Sunday, a holiday, and at the end of the day. We went for the first consultation, it was wonderful, but we needed to return for fluid therapy. The telephone contact with Dr. Leo was very attentive, the guidance was timely, and when he saw a worsening, he waited for us in the early morning, already preparing for hospitalization. This, for me, was fundamental, mainly because of the care! The clinic is excellent, the professionals are attentive, humane, with close contact with the pet owner. I wanted to thank Dr. Nicolle, Dr. Leo, Dr. Bruno, Dr. Nayara, and Dr. Júlia for the affection, care, and dedication to my Capitu (who is already affectionate and spoiled, she was treated as she demanded, haha), they saved her life, and I'm sure they were angels sent to help us in a super delicate moment.

The location is easily accessible and has attentive and caring professionals. The 24-hour service provides great security for those who have a pet needing more intensive care. Communication is also very good; they are quick and always available when needed.
I loved the service.

The clinic is wonderful, from the reception staff to the veterinarians. My elderly Shih Tzu arrived with a wound on her paw, and Dr. João treated her very well. With the prescribed medication, the wound is almost completely closed after 3 days of treatment. Dr. João's treatment was very effective. I highly recommend them; you can trust them.

My experience with Casa do Vet was exceptional. My Wally had his tartar cleaned, and whenever he needs it, he is very well taken care of by Dr. Bruno and the other friendly and competent doctors.
Tiffany is always attentive and warmly welcomes him for his weekly bath.
I can only express my gratitude.

I went to the clinic for the first time for my dog ​​to see a cardiologist, and from the moment I arrived at reception, where I was greeted by Bruna, until we entered the examination room (which took about 20 minutes), the treatment we received, both for myself and for him, was COMPLETELY cold!
At reception, I didn't receive any information about whether the doctor had arrived, if I should wait, or anything else. Just an 'okay' when I arrived and identified myself. When I went upstairs to wait to be called into the room, we were left 'abandoned' up there, with no one around, with a doctor who sometimes passed by but didn't even say good afternoon....
Only when I entered the room for my dog ​​to have the exam and be seen by Dr. Felipe did we receive some attention, from him and the assistant Andreza (who were kind and attentive during the appointment).
I've been taking my dog ​​to the same clinic since I adopted him (6 years ago), but since we now live far apart and I needed a specialist, I looked for references in Google reviews and chose this clinic, but I was disappointed with the reception.

I was sad because the reviews here are great, but unfortunately for me it was a terrible first impression!!!
I love the clinic! Dr. Bruno is excellent!

Wonderful.
Dr. Bruno is very competent, attentive, and caring.

He saved the life of my Biewer dog, which had eaten rat poison.

I discovered Casa do Vet during one of the most difficult times for me. My pet, Ragnar, fell ill during Carnival, and we needed urgent help. Thanks to Google reviews, we found this establishment. It was a necessary discovery. My first contact with Dr. Bruno was wonderful, and he provided excellent care, meticulously examining Ragnar and scheduling an emergency ultrasound for the same day. They found foreign bodies in my pet's stomach and intestines, but the team acted quickly and scheduled surgery for the same day. Everything went wonderfully well, and Ragnar spent three days hospitalized, receiving lots of pampering, the attention he needed during this vulnerable time, and the necessary medical care. My family and I are very grateful for everything this wonderful team did for us. Ragnar seems to share the same feeling, because whenever we pass by, he makes a point of going to the reception window and wagging his tail. Thank you to Dr. Bruno, Dr. Naiara, Dr. Lucas (Surgeon), Dr. Ariana (Endoscopy), and Dr. Diego (Anesthesia), as well as the entire nursing staff, reception, etc. You were all wonderful!
